name: Star Wars Mud
english_description: A Star Wars-themed extension built on top of the Lima mudlib (this project's own libs/lima, 164) -- its own README says it ships only 'additions and changes to the base mudlib' and must be installed over a real Lima install, which is exactly how this port was built: swmud's ~980-file tree overlaid onto a full copy of this project's already-converted Lima base. Ships a genuine Star Wars race roster (13 playable races across several human ethnicities plus aliens like Wookiees and Twi'leks), its own combat/limb/wound system, guild classes (Jedi, smuggler, bounty hunter, and more), crafting, and weapon/armor/lightsaber item trees. Porting it surfaced a large cluster of macro definitions that swmud's own header rewrites had silently dropped (despite swmud's own files and unmodified Lima files still depending on them), several places where swmud's rewritten combat/item API orphaned Lima's original demo content (left uncompiled, since none of it is part of swmud's real game world), and one severe, 100%-reproducible ordering bug that crashed the very first character ever created on any fresh install (an anti-cheat guard evaluated before the field it depends on was ever assigned). The real Star Wars starting area was never included in this git archive at all; new characters land in a real, working fallback room instead. Makes a genuine outbound network connection to the public Intermud-3 router at every boot.
